method: Independent model linguistic review of all 135 Spanish-only candidates and all supplied selected-source alternatives. Each approval binds one exact pinned Spanish record and zero-based sense, with an original model-translated selected English meaning, never an English-dictionary quotation or native-human certification. Literal animal, plant, material and weather-only finite agents are restricted to it-only; human operators and source-supported human bodily or figurative uses are distinguished. Adjectival renderings describe the selected property rather than inventing finite clauses. Retain regional, historical, technical and usage qualifications in context and notes. No inferred mandatory clitic, guessed paradigm, unsupported middle object or qualified English irregular inflection is authorized. Existing positive source-grammar, AGID, subject and aspect gates still apply. Potential form children are not verified translation coverage.

rejected.reason: Explicitly pronominal reciprocal or passive ayudarse; no implicit reflexive or reciprocal grammar authorized.
Relative quantity requires number-sensitive English much versus many; no single invariant adjective frame selected for the whole form family.
Demonstrative this versus these depends on the number of the possessed referent. Do not reuse an invariant adjective gloss across inflected forms; the separate eastward sense is not selected here.
Uncommon evanescer spelling cross-reference does not establish whether the subject makes something vanish or vanishes itself. Request exact construction proof.
Repeated gañir cross-reference leaves the precise animal-vocalization versus personal-complaint reading unresolved in the retained evidence. No subject frame selected confidently.
Explicitly pronominal rehurtarse; no implicit reflexive construction, even with an animal subject.
Explicitly pronominal remilgarse; no implicit reflexive construction.
Pronominal abofarse cross-reference is unresolved and does not authorize a bare predicate.
All retained meanings concern pronominal agallarse; no bare anger, courage or appropriation construction is authorized.
Explicitly pronominal pitarse; no implicit se despite a transitive label on one sense.
Quantity correlatives need number-sensitive much versus many or an exact corresponding clause. No invariant selected adjective for the entire family.
